description: Designs the outbound AI ports of an already-scoped use case — a language model asked for a structured answer (classify, extract, moderate) or an embedding model and a vector store asked for the nearest items (semantic search, duplicate detection) — into the `29-ai.md` partial: the prompt resources, the answer type with closed fields and what an unusable answer becomes, which fields go to the provider, the store and who re-indexes it, timeout and the one retrying layer, failure families, metrics, configuration and test cases, with Spring AI only in the adapter. Use when the request involves Spring AI, ChatClient, an LLM, OpenAI or Anthropic from Java, a prompt, structured output, embeddings, pgvector or a vector store. Piece of the `/new-feature` pipeline: requires `00-use-case.md` and a `10-domain.md` declaring a port of kind `LLM` or `vector store` in the given folder — and stops without them.
